 Client[\"Client Apps<br/>(Web / Mobile / Postman)\"]

 subgraph API[\"RetailLite API — /api/v1.0\"]
 direction TB

 UserC[\"UserController\"]

 end

 end

 subgraph Repos[\"Repository Layer (Spring Data JPA)\"]

 CategoryR[\"CategoryRepository\"]
 ProductR[\"ProductRepository\"]
 InventoryR[\"InventoryRepository\"]
 InvoiceR[\"InvoiceRepository · InvoiceItemsRepository\"]
 PaymentR[\"PaymentRepository\"]
 end
 end

 S3[[\"AWS S3 / Local Disk<br/>Product & Category Images\"]]
